expectations.evidence: Section 2 shows Before with is_confirmed/is_completed/is_cancelled BooleanFields and After with class Status(models.TextChoices) containing PENDING/CONFIRMED/COMPLETED/CANCELLED replacing all three booleans with a single status CharField.

expectations.text: settings를 base/local/production으로 분리하고 SECRET_KEY/DB 비밀번호를 django-environ으로 환경 변수 처리한다
expectations.evidence: Section 1 shows Before with hardcoded SECRET_KEY and DB PASSWORD in settings.py, and After with config/settings/base.py using import environ, env('DJANGO_SECRET_KEY'), env.db('DATABASE_URL'), plus config/settings/local.py and config/settings/production.py.

expectations.text: 뷰의 상태 검증 로직을 모델 메서드(confirm())로 이동시킨다
expectations.evidence: Section 5 shows Before with status checks (if apt.is_cancelled, if apt.is_completed) inline in AppointmentConfirmView.post(), and After with confirm() method on the Appointment model containing the validation logic, while the view simply calls appointment.confirm().

expectations.text: fields='__all__'을 명시적 필드 목록으로 교체하고, Serializer를 액션별로 분리한다
expectations.evidence: Section 6 shows Before with fields='__all__' on a single AppointmentSerializer, and After with three separate serializers: AppointmentListSerializer (list), AppointmentDetailSerializer (detail), AppointmentCreateSerializer (create), each with explicit fields lists.

Section 5 Before shows apt.save() with no arguments. After shows self.save(update_fields=['status', 'updated_at']) in confirm(), complete(), and cancel() model methods. The update_fields includes 'status' as required.
